verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing says its business account lets you 'unlock up to 3.70%', so yield on balances exists. Nothing shows that interest accrues on balances held in multiple currencies. The '120+ countries' and 'global payments' claims cover payments and coverage, not multi-currency interest-bearing balances. Missing for 10: evidence of interest on non-USD or multi-currency balances, documentation of rates and terms per currency, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the yield.
